label: Trend in annual floods
describe: Sen's slope of the annual maximum daily flow, in per cent of its mean per decade, over complete hydrological years; Mann-Kendall p-value.

label: Trend in low flows
describe: Sen's slope of the annual minimum 7-day mean flow, in per cent of its mean per decade, over complete climate years; Mann-Kendall p-value.

label: Baseflow index
describe: The share of the flow that is baseflow, from the Lyne-Hollick filter (alpha 0.925, three passes) the Archive runs on every mirrored record.
